def join_pair(a: str, b: str) -> str:
    """Join a and b with a vertical bar between them."""
    ex join_pair("x", "y") == "x|y"
    ex join_pair("", "") == "|"
    return a + "|" + b

def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Return the contents of path and of notes/../secret.txt, joined by "|".
    Each read that fails contributes an empty string."""
    pre path.byte_len() >= 0
    post out.count("|") == 1
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return join_pair(mine, theirs)

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Run plugin(path) with fs narrowed to the notes directory, so the plugin
    can read only below notes. Paths are relative to notes, and any read that
    would leave notes yields an empty string."""
    post out.count("|") == 1
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        return plugin(path)
